description: Unit tests for LoadBalancerServerId class in the quiche QUIC load balancer module, testing creation, comparison, accessor functions, equality, and hashing.

classes.name: LoadBalancerServerIdTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for LoadBalancerServerId unit tests.

methods.name: CreateReturnsNullIfTooLong
methods.description: Tests that creating a LoadBalancerServerId with invalid lengths (0 and 16) triggers bug expectations.

methods.name: CompareIdenticalExceptLength
methods.description: Tests comparison operators when server IDs are identical except for length.

methods.name: AccessorFunctions
methods.description: Verifies data accessors and string conversion for a server ID.

methods.name: CompareDifferentServerIds
methods.description: Tests comparison between different server IDs, including order based on content.

methods.name: EqualityOperators
methods.description: Checks equality and inequality operators for server IDs.

methods.name: SupportsHash
methods.description: Verifies that server IDs can be hashed correctly and that hash-based functions work as expected.
